results.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa - BBC
results.snippet: # Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa. Nigeria has recorded a case of Ebola in a female patient who travelled from Uganda in East Africa to Abuja, capital of the West African state. The patient is in isolation and receiving medical care after being admitted to a hospital in Abuja. Nigeria, the first West African state to report a case linked to the current Ebola crisis in East Africa
